display.purpose: Screen titles and hero numerals only.

body.purpose: All task controls, rows, coaching copy, and data.

label.purpose: Captions, field labels, and quiet metadata.

motion.name: standard
motion.purpose: State feedback only, with no choreography.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The single clear action for a training decision.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: #FF5C2A; color: #0D0D0F; font: 700 0.875rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255,92,42,0.12); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF8A66; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Training Input
components.description: A clear recessed field for weight, reps, names, and notes.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 42px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 8px; outline: none; background: #28282C; color: #F4F4F2; font: 400 1rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5F5F66; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #FF5C2A; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,92,42,0.14); }

components.name: Equipment Chip
components.description: A selectable piece of available equipment.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 8px; background: #28282C; color: #9C9CA3; font: 700 0.75rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip:hover, .ds-chip:focus-visible { color: #F4F4F2; border-color: #FF5C2A; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF8A66; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Training Card
components.description: A grouped training decision or summary, separated by tone rather than a heavy outline.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 16px; border-radius: 12px; background: #161618; color: #F4F4F2; font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: #9C9CA3; }

components.name: Active Navigation
components.description: A familiar mobile destination marker, with ember reserved for the current screen.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 20px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 18px; background: #161618; color: #9C9CA3; font: 700 0.75rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav .is-active { color: #FF5C2A; }

narrative.overview: Fitness Tracker is a focused training tool for phone use before and during workouts. Ember on Graphite keeps the athlete's attention on the next meaningful action, durable training data, and honest AI feedback.
keyCharacteristics: Honest AI and camera state feedback

rules.name: The Ember Rule
rules.body: Ember means tap, active, or selected, never decoration or data.

rules.name: The Data Rule
rules.body: Data values use primary text and are never ember-colored merely to draw attention.

dos: Do use the existing graphite surfaces and ember action color exactly as defined in docs/DESIGN_TOKENS.md.
Do keep camera, upload, save, and delete controls familiar and obvious.
donts: Don't add decorative cyber or neon styling that competes with workout data.
Don't create dense spreadsheet-style logging during an active session.
Don't let AI language overclaim what the Coach can see, has saved, or has changed.
